{{Quote|Back during my days with the Rebel Alliance, I had a suit of camo armor in my X-wing's survival gear kit. When I got shot down over Atrivis, it helped me evade the Storm Commandos until I could steal another ship.|Homack|<ref name="GFT" />}}
'''Homack''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. While fighting as an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Homack saw action over [[Atrivis]] but was shot down and pursued by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] [[Planet/Legends|planetside]]. Homack managed to escape the Imperials and, while on a separate ground mission to the planet [[Hethar]], was attacked by [[shredder bat]]s. After retiring from the Alliance, the veteran occasionally commented in ''[[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Almost in unison, we turned on those excluders. Shredder bats literally fell out of the sky as their senses got scrambled.|Homack|<ref name="GFT" />}}
Homack was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. While flying an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], the pilot was involved in an engagement over the planet [[Atrivis]], and was shot down. Pursued on the planet's surface by [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]],<ref name="GFT" /> elite [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] units specially trained in commando tactics,<ref name="Rules of Engagement">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> Homack was able to successfully evade them with the help of a set of [[Creshaldyne Industries/Legends|Creshaldyne Industries]] [[camo scout armor]]. Stored in the starfighter's survival gear kit, the suit was capable of mimicking surrounding terrain by generating a small holographic distortion, thus enabling Homack to avoid capture long enough to steal a ship and escape the planet.<ref name="GFT" />

[[File:Shredder_bat.jpg|thumb|right|Shredder bats, such as these, attacked Homack while on the planet Hethar.]]
On another mission, this time to the planet [[Hethar]], Homack and a number of other Rebels were investigating an Imperial contingent. Spending a night on the planet, Homack was on night duty with three other Rebels when they were attacked by [[shredder bat]]s.<ref name="GFT" /> The creatures, known to hunt in packs, were armed with sharp fangs with which they tried to pierce their target's coronary arteries.<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Homack and the sentries were able to avoid such an attack by activating their [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[Excluder]]s. Small sonic devices that emitted waves of high frequency sound, they scrambled the bats' senses, causing them to fall from the sky. The sentries were then able to kill the creatures without drawing Imperial attention, or even waking the other Rebels. The bats were later enjoyed as breakfast the next day.<ref name="GFT" />

After retiring from the Rebellion, Homack posted a number of comments and reviews on equipment in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. Three of these made their way into ''[[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]''. For instance, when discussing the [[A3AA personal defense module]] created by [[Corellian Technologies/Legends|Corellian Technologies]], Homack recommended using [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] or [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] to overcome the suit dissipation field.<ref name="GFT" />

==Personality and traits==
As a Rebel, Homack took precautions to ensure survival, such as storing camo scout armor aboard starfighters in case of crash landings, or carrying animal excluders. The Rebel was also happy to share opinions and past experiences on message boards.<ref name="GFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Homack was created for ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'' ([[1997]]) where the character commented on three pieces of equipment. The comments originate from a planet with the code "Bst," which may be [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine]], or less notably, [[Bseto I]]. The in-universe comments throughout the book were intended to function as scenario hooks or potential modifications.<ref name="GFT" /> Given the action on the planet Atrivis, Homack may have been a member of the [[Atrivis Sector Force]], which coordinated Rebel activity in the sector.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook SE">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
